findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ptcg_goldfish · Private data: ptcg_draw_odds, ptcg_prize_odds, ptcg_goldfish · Public sink: ptcg_draw_odds, ptcg_prize_odds, ptcg_goldfish · Destructive: ptcg_opening_hand_odds.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ptcg_goldfish · Private data: ptcg_draw_odds, ptcg_prize_odds, ptcg_goldfish · Public sink: ptcg_draw_odds, ptcg_prize_odds, ptcg_goldfish · Destructive: ptcg_opening_hand_odds

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
